# nuthatch nest on mainnet

A self-hosted blockchain index. Query it locally; there is no third-party API.

## Contracts
- `c0` = 0x00000000000c2e074ec69a0dfb2997ba6c7d2e1e

## Tables (one per contract event)
- `c0__approval_for_all` - ApprovalForAll(address,address,bool) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, owner, operator, approved)
- `c0__new_owner` - NewOwner(bytes32,bytes32,address) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, node, label, owner)
- `c0__new_resolver` - NewResolver(bytes32,address) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, node, resolver)
- `c0__new_t_t_l` - NewTTL(bytes32,uint64) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, node, ttl)
- `c0__transfer` - Transfer(bytes32,address) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, node, owner)

## Live HTTP API (run `nuthatch dev`)
- `GET /`                    index status
- `GET /tables`              every table with its columns
- `GET /table/{name}?limit=N` recent rows of one table (hot + sealed)
- `GET /entity/{id}`         one row by id (`{block:012}-{logindex:06}`)
- `GET /sql?q=SELECT...`     read-only SQL; each table is a view named `{alias}__{event}`
- `GET /balances?limit=N`    top holder balances (when an ERC-20 Transfer table is present)
- `GET /balance/{address}`   one address's derived balance

## MCP (for coding agents)
Run `nuthatch mcp` (stdio) to expose tools: status, schema, tables, table, sql, entity,
balance, top_balances. Fully offline against the local instance; nothing phones home.
